source_pr_title: docs(spec): acp edge design — proxy vs agent mode, hook↔ACP event mapping (bro-rs8sp)
author: kilo-code-bot
body: **WARNING:** The spec claims unbadged proxy runs archive under a proxy-scoped plane dir, but the mechanism it names (`agentTurnPlane` in `packages/providers/src/acp-events.ts`) skips archiving entirely when `BRO_AGENT_ID` is unset — `file` resolves to `undefined` and `record()` returns early (acp-events.ts:115-119, 146-149). The test suite asserts this explicitly ("unbadged turns ... never write an archive", acp-events.test.ts:134-153). Either the code must derive an archive path independent of the worker badge, or the spec must state that unbadged runs do not archive — the current text asserts behavior the named mechanism does not have.
